description: Phase 3 monitoring policy for the historical replay of BusTravelTimePredictor. All thresholds are calibrated on in-control reference data at run time; the numbers below are false-alarm targets, not fixed statistic cut-offs.

reference.inputs: Training split of the approved v1 model (2019-07-01 to 2019-07-03, IST).
reference.performance: Approved v1 validation errors (2019-07-05). This is the error level the model was approved at.

replay.label_arrival: A traversal's observed duration becomes available when the bus exits the segment (t_exit).

monitored_features.note: segment_length_km and the cold-start history features are fixed functions of segment_id; sin_time and cos_time are fixed functions of minute_of_day.

performance_detector.method: One-sided CUSUM on |error| divided by the error expected for that segment and time-of-day period under approval conditions
performance_detector.calibration_note: Thresholds come from a circular block bootstrap of the approved validation errors in label-arrival order, which keeps congestion-driven error clusters together.

natural.title: Natural replay (no injection)
natural.description: Real held-out traffic of 5 and 8 July 2019 replayed in time order through the approved model.

covariate_shift.title: Induced data drift: demand shift
covariate_shift.description: From 8 July, the request mix shifts toward the Outer Ring Road eastbound segment served by the API (real traversals resampled with their real labels).

concept_drift.title: Induced model drift: road works
concept_drift.description: From 10:00 on 8 July, riding time on the Outer Ring Road eastbound segment rises by 60% (inputs unchanged).

data_quality.title: Induced data-quality fault: timezone bug
data_quality.description: From 12:00 on 8 July, 40% of requests send UTC clock time labelled as IST (5 h 30 min early) and 10% carry an unregistered route code.

runbook.input_drift: Investigate the request mix and upstream feeds. Drift is a signal, not proof of model error: do not retrain on input drift alone.
runbook.prediction_drift: Check whether the input change explains the prediction change; compare with delayed labels before acting.
runbook.data_quality: Quarantine the affected batch, exclude it from any retraining data and notify the data owner. Fix the feed before trusting drift statistics.
runbook.performance: Open a retraining candidate on the latest complete labelled days. The candidate must pass the promotion policy; the serving version stays unchanged until it does.
